summary: Implements Array.prototype.find per spec: ToObject, LengthOfArrayLike, then a private FindViaPredicate helper (ascending only) doing IsCallable check, then per-index ToString key, Get, Call(predicate, thisArg, «kValue, k, obj»), ToBoolean, and returning (-1, undefined) when nothing matches. Every abrupt completion is propagated with `?`, step order matches the spec, and no inputs are special-cased. The 6 remaining failures are BigInt not-implemented errors from the test harness, not from this code.
